report:
# PrimeSieve 413731 follow-up: release-source correctness

Released frozen source `release_frozen.hpp` is23288 bytes, SHA-256 `dcd12c2562226efee621747edff3cbbfcf0b85e031d06da53a0f114e6b15500c`. It fuses masks for13/17,19/23,29/31,37/41 and retains262144 odd bits per block for all compilers, unless the original root-based lower bound requires more. All existing public APIs, prime restoration through127 and AVX2 count code are present. This report verifies this frozen adopted source only; it does not relabel the earlier online AC for the01344c28 baseline. No repository source was edited by this validation task.

All24 configurations passed:

- Twelve C++23 builds: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8 × checked/skip × default-O2, SIMD-disabled-O2, ASan+UBSan-O1.
- Eight native builds: GCC/Clang × checked/skip × SIMD enabled/disabled, -O2 -march=native.
- Four allocation-failure builds: GCC/Clang × checked/skip, each12 assertions and0 live allocations, without sanitizer allocation interception.

All compiler diagnostics and runtime stderr are empty. Builds use CPU10, functional runs CPU2. Matrix dependency files name release_frozen.hpp and readelf .comment records the actual compiler. Test durations are not performance evidence. ASan uses detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1; UBSan uses halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1. LeakSanitizer was not run.

The independent oracle is an elementary full-integer byte sieve through4,200,000. It shares neither odd-only layout, mask patterns, fused-mask generation nor blocked striking with the candidate. It supplies complete expected prime vectors and individual primality bits. Each run covers1484 distinct limits and6,371,194 primality queries. New assertions:6,389,206 checked/SIMD enabled,6,387,722 skip/SIMD enabled,6,384,310 checked/SIMD disabled,6,382,826 skip/SIMD disabled. Disabled builds omit4896 direct AVX2 helper comparisons. The previous repository suite additionally passes675840/675360/674786/674306 assertions, including known prime counts at10M/100M.

New fused-mask boundaries are derived independently from periods221,437,899,1517. For4096-word blocks1/3/7 and8192-word blocks1/3, the oracle cases cover the nonzero starting phase's alignment prefix, prefix+one complete period, each±1word, and each final word±1bit. The8192-word block7 would exceed4.2M and is deliberately excluded. This explicitly covers prefix exhaustion with no remaining words, one-word tails, exact period completion and period remainders at subsequent blocks. Full prime-vector comparisons verify all flags in each tested interval, not only sampled prime counts.

Prior1151 cases remain unchanged. They include every0..255 limit; blocked-build threshold262144; restored primes through127 including bit63 of word0; prime squares3..131 and larger roots; 4096-word block tails;1155-word initial-fill period1/2/3/7/14/28±1word±1bit; 255/256/257-word popcount boundaries; and deterministic random limits. Limits262144 and4194304 compare every integer, including all restored presieve primes. Full enumeration, exact count, prefix-preserving append, callback enumeration, wrapper overloads, callback exceptions, copies/moves/self-assignment, moved-from reuse and independent ownership are checked.

The historical MEDIUM_BOUNDARY line in test output merely names general prime-count data near1742537/1742539. The candidate has no special medium enumeration helper or131072-prime branch.

Direct carry-save and wrapper tests use zero/all-one/alternating/single-bit/density-step/random words, four unaligned offsets, selected counts0..32, and±4 around64/128/192/256/320/384/512/1024/4096/65536. Both functions match scalar std::popcount, including carry propagation and all tails. The copied existing test has an explicit return0 before its main is macro-renamed; this harness-only change avoids ordinary-function fallthrough. Repository tests are untouched.

All measured GCC/Clang default/native configurations use4096-word blocks. The mathematical root-based lower bound is retained for larger inputs. GCC default builds have neither BMI2 nor AVX2 feature macros and therefore exercise the portable rotate-based strike. GCC native has BMI2 and exercises the old4-unroll strike. Clang default/native also use the old strike. The test positions after8192-word offsets now correspond to two standard blocks; they remain valid phase and remainder boundaries. Actual conditional macros are recorded. SIMD-disabled default/native builds are also checked independently; all eight symbol tables have neither CPU dispatch (__cpu_) nor AVX2/carry-save helper symbols. The fused standard-C++ mask loops remain present and may be auto-vectorized by compiler options; absence of all SIMD instructions is not claimed.

Evidence:

- extended.cpp SHA-256:d89c7e4cf4f33f641426267ee74071110e0137df1565a4328209cd6c58be6d18
- release/results.json:12 configurations and actual commands/outputs/hashes.
- release/allocation.json:4 allocation-failure configurations.
- release_native/results.json:8 native configurations.
- release/fallback-symbol-proof.json:8 SIMD-disabled symbol checks.
- release/conditional-macros.json:actual default/native feature macros.
- release/hashes.json and per-build .d/.comment/.compile/.run logs.
- release-summary.json:concise aggregate.

Earlier baseline and candidate results under the413720 validation directory are preserved separately and are not reused as this candidate's24 configurations.

The rejected8f block64 candidate remains separately under final/ and final_native/, with REJECTED_BLOCK64_REPORT.md and final-summary.json. Its earlier24 results are not relabeled as the adopted ce1 source.

Release cleanup explicitly uses std::uint64_t for the fused-mask constexpr bit index and Period*64 bound. The algorithms, mask pairs and4096-word block selection remain the same. This report uses newly executed dcd12c25-source24 results; it does not substitute the earlier ce1 records. Earlier ce1 results remain under adopted/ and adopted_native/, with ADOPTED_CE1_REPORT.md and adopted-summary.json.

run_matrix.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp,json,hashlib,os,time,sys
p=Path(__file__).parent
source=Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else p/'baseline.hpp'
tag=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'baseline'
out=p/tag;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(out/'hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(f):sha(f) for f in [source,p/'extended.cpp',p/'existing_simd_test.cpp',p/'allocation_test.cpp',Path(__file__)]},indent=2)+'\n')
records=[]
for compiler,cc in [('gcc15_2',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang21',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for check in ['checked','skip']:
  for mode in ['default','standard','asan_ubsan']:
   name=f'{compiler}_{check}_{mode}';binary=out/name
   flags=['-std=c++23','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic','-MMD','-MF',str(binary)+'.d',f'-DSIEVE_SOURCE="{source}"']
   flags+=['-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer'] if mode=='asan_ubsan' else ['-O2']
   if check=='skip':flags+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   if mode=='standard':flags+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
   cmd=['taskset','-c','10',*cc,*flags,str(p/'extended.cpp'),'-o',str(binary)]
   row=dict(name=name,compile_command=cmd,source_sha256=sha(source));start=time.perf_counter()
   q=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);row.update(compile_exit=q.returncode,compile_stderr=q.stderr,compile_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start);Path(str(binary)+'.compile.log').write_text(q.stdout+q.stderr)
   if q.returncode==0:
    row['dep_verified']=str(source) in Path(str(binary)+'.d').read_text();row['binary_sha256']=sha(binary)
    Path(str(binary)+'.comment.txt').write_text(sp.check_output(['readelf','-p','.comment',str(binary)],text=True))
    env=os.environ.copy();env['ASAN_OPTIONS']='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1';env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
    run=['taskset','-c','2',str(binary)];start=time.perf_counter();q=sp.run(run,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
    row.update(run_command=run,run_exit=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr,run_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,ASAN_OPTIONS=env['ASAN_OPTIONS'],UBSAN_OPTIONS=env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']);Path(str(binary)+'.run.log').write_text(q.stdout+q.stderr)
   records.append(row);(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');print(name,row.get('compile_exit'),row.get('run_exit'),row.get('stdout','').strip(),flush=True)
   if row.get('run_exit')!=0:raise SystemExit('Matrix failure')
# Allocation-failure harness deliberately replaces global allocation functions; run independently, without ASan interceptors.
alloc=[]
for compiler,cc in [('gcc15_2',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang21',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for check in ['checked','skip']:
  binary=out/f'alloc_{compiler}_{check}';cmd=['taskset','-c','10',*cc,'-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic',f'-DSIEVE_SOURCE="{source}"',*(['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']if check=='skip'else[]),str(p/'allocation_test.cpp'),'-o',str(binary)]
  q=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);row=dict(compiler=compiler,check=check,compile_command=cmd,compile_exit=q.returncode,compile_stderr=q.stderr)
  if q.returncode==0:
   q=sp.run(['taskset','-c','2',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True);row.update(run_exit=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr)
  alloc.append(row);(out/'allocation.json').write_text(json.dumps(alloc,indent=2)+'\n');print('allocation',compiler,check,row.get('run_exit'),row.get('stdout','').strip(),flush=True)
  if row.get('run_exit')!=0:raise SystemExit('Allocation failure')
print('DONE',tag,sha(source),flush=True)
